title: npm 11 drops a bin path written with ./
trigger: Before publishing deltadictum or editing bin in package.json
behavior_delta: Write bin paths without a leading ./ ("src/cli.js"). Before publishing, read package.json out of the packed tarball (npm pack, then tar --force-local -xOf) to confirm bin survived, and watch for 'npm auto-corrected some errors' in npm publish output.
what: Write bin paths without a leading ./ ("src/cli.js"). Before publishing, read package.json out of the packed tarball (npm pack, then tar --force-local -xOf) to confirm bin survived, and watch for 'npm auto-corrected some errors' in npm publish output.
why: npm 11.6 removed "./src/cli.js" as an invalid script name at publish time, only as a warning, which would have shipped the package without its deltadictum command and broken the Codex install.
trigger_variants: Publish a new version to npm
Publicar una version nueva en npm
